text:
kenji: quick check — for /v1/generate when we return structured outputs, do we prefer omitting optional fields or returning them as null? clients are seeing different behavior across SDKs and it's causing parsing differences.

olivia: iirc we leaned toward omitting absent optional keys to keep payload smaller. but we documented `nullable: true` on a few fields which is confusing.

samir: that mismatch is exactly the problem. JSON Schema's `nullable` leads some generators to always include the key with null. others omit. we need a single source of truth.

maya: +1. for backward compatibility, omitting keys is safer in many clients (esp typed languages) — but some consumers explicitly rely on presence (null) to mean "field considered".

kenji: proposal: API returns absent for optional unless explicitly set to null by model. we'll update openapi to clarify: use `x-omit-if-null: true` (or similar) in docs and add a note in SDKs.

olivia: sounds reasonable. also we should enforce `Content-Type: application/json` for structured endpoints — streaming endpoints are a different beast.

samir: +1 on content-type enforcement. note: some proxies add `charset=utf-8` and older clients choke on strict matching. suggest we accept `application/json*` and normalize in gateways.

kenji: good point. action items: 1) update openapi schema with explicit guidance on optional fields 2) add a lightweight validator that flags null-vs-missing diffs in our integration tests 3) add a note in SDK generators so they don't force keys.

maya: i can take the validator tests. will add a small e2e that compares model outputs against canonical schema for a few prompts and fails when a field pattern flips.

olivia: i'll update the openapi docs and the consumer-facing docs. also will add a clear example section showing preferred/allowed shapes:

```json
// preferred (omit absent)
{
  "id": "abc123",
  "metadata": {
    "lang": "en"
  }
}

// allowed explicit null only when model intentionally returns null
{
  "id": "abc123",
  "metadata": null
}
```

samir: for the validator: let's also allow a transitional mode that flags but doesn't fail for 2 weeks after a change. that will help customers migrate.

kenji: agree — implement a `soft-fail` flag in CI for a rollout window.

devex-bot: Heads up — API docs PR template updated to include "schema-change migration plan" checklist.

maya: pinging @samir for a quick review when i open the validator PR.

samir: i'll review. can you also include a unit that simulates SDK parsing behavior (ts/py/java) so we catch gotchas?

maya: yep, will add simple parsing tests across 3 SDKs.

kenji: thanks team. i'll open a tiny RFC PR linking these tasks and propose the openapi change. tagging retention: please comment if you want the transitional window longer than 2 weeks. :slightly_smiling_face:
